$description: PROPOSAL (proof of concept) — motion tokens for explainer illustrations only. Kept apart from primitive/semantic duration+easing, which belong to components (80–300ms UI feedback). Illustration motion is storytelling: slower, choreographed in scenes, looping. A component must never read these; an illustration must never read the component ones.

exit.$description: An element leaves — always shorter than enter

emphasis.$description: A pop with overshoot — the thing to look at

draw.$description: A connector line draws from A to B

recolor.$description: A fill changes color in place

stagger.$description: Delay between siblings entering one after another

hold.$description: How long a finished scene stays still so it can be read

exit.$description: Symmetric in-out for leaving and transitions

emphasis.$description: Overshoot — reserve for the one element each scene is about

draw.$description: Even in-out so a line reads as travelling
